surprises.head: Edmonton won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Anaheim, 3.2 to 2.6, with empty nets left out. D. Levi stopped 1.2 more goals than expected.

surprises.head: Anaheim shot far more than usual
surprises.body: 75.5 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 59.8.

surprises.head: Edmonton tried a different line
surprises.body: I. Howard, J. Samanski, M. Jones played 5:31 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Edmonton’s usual lines.
